game.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
game.blurb: Open-world Viking action RPG set in ninth-century England, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2020-11-10. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Eivor's clan leaves Norway to make a new home in England. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploring England
chapters.summary: Standing Stones, Cairns, World Events, treasure hoards, Roman artifacts, Orlog, flytings, fishing, Alpha animals, Tombs of the Fallen and completing territories.

chapters.title: Settlement, Gear and Abilities
chapters.summary: Growing the settlement, abilities, mastery points, gear upgrades and Power.

chapters.title: Combat and Stealth
chapters.summary: Assassinations, blending in, raiding on the longship and tough fights.

chapters.title: Wrath of the Druids (DLC)
chapters.summary: Ireland: its territories, Dublin Renown, Royal Demands and the Morrigan.

chapters.title: The Siege of Paris (DLC)
chapters.summary: Francia: the campaign, Rebel Missions, the Frankish nobles and the Ghost Auroch.

chapters.title: Dawn of Ragnarök (DLC)
chapters.summary: Svartalfheim: the campaign, the Shelters, Muspelheim Monoliths and new powers.

chapters.title: The Forgotten Saga (mode)
chapters.summary: Odin's Camp, Niflheim, Nar's Favors and Hel.

chapters.title: Mastery Challenge
chapters.summary: Earning gold medals in the Mastery Challenge.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2208920)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (assassinscreed.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://assassinscreed.fandom.com/wiki/Assassin's_Creed:_Valhalla
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Assassin's Creed Valhalla" or "Assassin's Creed: Valhalla". assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under "Assassin's Creed: Valhalla", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 31 of 92 Steam achievements are hidden. Most DLC achievements name their DLC in brackets; 9 hidden ones listed inside those DLC blocks were placed by schema position ("Ireland's Deliverance" and three others to Wrath of the Druids, three to Dawn of Ragnarök, two to The Forgotten Saga), which needs checking. The other 22 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; several with low unlock rates (such as "Caladfwlch", "Seahorse", "The Hidden Truth", "Godly Reward", "Worthy", "A Picture of Grace") are probably optional content. The Forgotten Saga is labelled a mode only because its achievements sit together; the data does not say whether it is paid DLC. Tombs of the Fallen carry no DLC tag and were put with exploring England.
